reported_version.description: The version the reporter runs (e.g. 1.4.2 or v1.4.2), or null when the report does not say. 'main' or a branch name is not a version.

search_phrases.description: A few short phrases to search other issues with: exact error messages, exception names, function or option names, the key terms of the request.

file_paths.description: Repository file paths named in the report (e.g. from a traceback), as written.
